Supplying & Fixing open gym equipment - Air walker made up to of tubular steel of 2.5mm thickness, all galvanized and zinc dipped, joints are robotic welded, all welded joints are scalled as necessary and welded to a approved MIG process. All welds are dressed off removing all sharp edges and burrs. Zinc primer paint is applied all the welding points prior to finishing. All metal parts are poeder coated using AKZO noble - grade wall poeder to the thickness of 80 to 120microns. All metal parts are to be tested in salt spray machine that uses a 5% NACL solution in accordance to ISO 7227 to handle corrosion for 3000 hours. High quality grip rubber is used for the handles, maintainance free ball bearing scope of delivery : 1 completely free assembled equipment model. Maintain according to EN 16630 and as per the maintainance guide. All product must be tested and certified to meet EN 16630 safety standards with GS test mark. The EN 16630 certificates must be issued by a reputed notified international certifying agency such as IPEMA, TUV, CPSC or SGS only. The GS mark EN 16630 certificates must be in the name of tendering party and not any 3rd party. All products must clearly disply the GS mark as issued in the EN 16630 safety certicates.
